text:
From the forest's edge, a Traveler would not know where to find a 
way into the sprawling tunnels of the Ohlroot until they chanced 
upon the massive stumps within the heart of the Last Bloom 
forest. Remnants of colossal sequoias that once dominated the 
Wealdwoods, now petrified into gaping entrances dozens of feet 
wide. These tunnels, once the thick roots that drank deep of the 
soil for miles, now hollowed out and petrified, feature a twisting 
web of mold-lit channels that run just under the earth, a mere 
dozen feet from the arboreal beasts that tread above. 
With numerous entrances from the forest above, the ecosystem 
of the Ohlroot and Last Bloom blend as tormull come and go 
between the safety of the dark tunnels below with their skittering 
larvae, and above to chew on the mulch of rotten wood. Korrask 
often dig great burrows that break into the tunnels, their scythe-
like mandibles poised to slice trespassers on the ground while 
their more vulnerable undersides lay exposed below. Ever-
numerous scavick are found in the sprawls of the Olhroot more 
than anywhere as their heightened sense of smell is perfectly 
adapted for the shallow burrows, leaving them a safe escape from 
the larger predators that glide between the towering trees. 
 
While dangerous to venture into the Olhroot, a Traveler may find 
quicker routes through the Wealdwoods by venturing beneath the 
tangle of thorn and bramble, and in the tunnels below, they must 
just be sure they can find their way back out. 
Seeping wet ceilings drip foulness from the marshlands above 
with twisting blue veins of azacrid glimmer with the light of the 
bog bacteria within the ankle-deep tunnels that make up the 
Undermoor. Entrances to the sodden darkness below often look 
to be just wide puddles on the moors, their calm, black surface 
obscuring hidden depths. 
Only after swimming dozens of feet in terrifying darkness would 
a Traveler find themselves in the stifling air of the caves. Filled 
with fungi and insects that feast on the rich decomposed organic 
material that leaks from the peat bogs above, surrounded by an 
ecosystem that thrives off of rot. Skith skitter at this level, their 
long tails and articulated finned legs perfectly suited to the variety 
of half submerged tunnels.
Below the waves, cavern entrances bore into the undersea cliffs, 
choked by encroaching coral and the invading denizens of the 
ocean. Daellash and esslinter vie for territory in these darkened 
depths, viciously attacking each other on sight, as both compete 
for the winding claustrophobic tunnels. 
If a Traveler can swim past these embattled waterways, they may 
then find themselves in the drier, pitch black caves of cold bedrock. 
While devoid of many of the light-giving fungi and bacteria seem 
in other caverns, these deep chasms still glitter like the starry sky 
above when reflecting the light of a Traveler's torch. Seams of 
charcoal and rare diamonds offer a treasure trove to mine, if one 
can pry them loose without disturbing the blind acrynn below.
Ohlroot
Undermoor
Overlooking the Grayfynn plains, these caverns rest high on the cliff faces that rise up to form the Tundrus highlands. The cavern 
entrances guarded by the comings and going of tormull as they descend into the Arborne forests below to chew through plant matter, 
before returning to their swarming brood within the caves. Tunneling dig deep under the Tundrus plain, stalactites and stalagmites 
crowd the tight confines as fungal growths light the labyrinthine maze with life. Bioluminescent spores dance on the still air while 
mollock crawl in great numbers, feasting on the plethora of mushrooms and carrying their spores along the winding tunnels in their 
fur to spread them further. Under these overlapping fungal growths lie a healthy layer of infernoil that clings to the stalactites, creating 
an ideal foundation for the underworld’s flora. As bountiful and idyllic as this lit underworld may seem at first glance, long tendrils 
hang from the ceiling from large chitinous mollucite, patiently wait to snag any passing prey that nears their grasping viscid tongues.

Locations of the Umbrawells
Lands Unseen
Rising within the highest mountain range on Sol’Kesh, great vaults of open space reveal an underworld like no other. The softest 
sounds echo throughout the levels that stretch upwards. Near the peak, great breaches puncture the walls, some leading deeper into 
the earth while others let in the light of the day. Deep within the mountain, a kind of light illuminates the hollow core of the Splitspine 
mountains as massive lanternulls radiate a warming glow that lights the roaming swarms of mollock above. Slithering in the cracks 
beneath, krainis blindly search for the bodies of careless bats that have fallen from the heights above, their sensitive heat pits sensing 
the slowly cooling bodies of the small mammals. Within the spire of the largest mountain, feasting on nesting skyelarx that take shelter 
above the cloud line, the web-lined lairs of taurachni can be found. Though too large to hang from silken threads like smaller arachnids, 
their massive armored bodies are surprisingly agile as their eight chitinous limbs nimbly climb along the cavernous walls, the clatter 
of their hungering mandibles echoing in the vaulted within the hollow mountain.
